minimum_external_inputs: A validated PPARG-DINP system.xml generated with an explicit-solvent protein force field and validated DINP ligand parameters
A topology PDB with atom order identical to system.xml
An equilibrated/minimized starting PDB or the recommended complex PDB after external system building
recommended_production: 100 ns NPT at 310 K, 2 fs timestep, three seeds if compute budget permits
interpretation_boundary: MD stability supports structural plausibility only; it does not establish experimental affinity or causal PPARG-to-CEBPB regulation.
